newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives will unite to keep power-chairman.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives will unite to keep power-chairman.

text.p: Ruling Conservative chairman Brian Mawhinney on Monday dismissed the defection of an ex-treasurer of the ruling party, Lord McAlpine, as irrelevant and said the party would unite at its Bournemouth conference this week behind a common desire to win the coming UK general election.
Asked by ITV whether McAlpine's switch to Sir James Goldsmith's Referendum party was an irrelevance, Mawhinney said: "That's my view, and I have said so."

The Conservatives shared a deep determination to win a fifth consecutive term of office, he said: "That's what will focus the minds of the party at this conference and over the months to election day."
